<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Jobs\GenerateThumbnail;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Device;
use App\Models\MonitoringPolicy;
use App\Models\Screenshot;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\Audit;
use App\Services\Vault;
use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AgentController extends Controller
{
    public function info(): JsonResponse
    {
        return response()->json(['policy' => MonitoringPolicy::current()]);
    }

    public function login(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['email' => 'required|email', 'password' => 'required|string', 'device_identifier' => 'required|uuid', 'device_name' => 'required|string|max:120', 'os' => 'required|string|max:80', 'notice_accepted' => 'required|accepted']);
        $user = User::where('email', strtolower($data['email']))->first();
        if (! $user || ! $user->enabled || $user->role !== 'employee' || ! Hash::check($data['password'], $user->password)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['email' => 'Invalid employee credentials or disabled account.']);
        }
        $policy = MonitoringPolicy::current();
        $result = DB::transaction(function () use ($user, $data, $policy): array {
            $user = User::whereKey($user->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            abort_unless($user->enabled, 403, 'Account disabled.');
            $device = Device::where('device_identifier', $data['device_identifier'])->lockForUpdate()->first();
            abort_if($device && ($device->user_id !== $user->id || $device->disabled_at), 403, 'This device is disabled or belongs to another employee.');
            $device ??= new Device(['device_identifier' => $data['device_identifier'], 'user_id' => $user->id]);
            if ($device->token_id) {
                $user->tokens()->whereKey($device->token_id)->delete();
            }
            $expiry = now()->addDays(config('tracker.token_days'));
            $token = $user->createToken('device:'.$data['device_identifier'], ['device:collect'], $expiry);
            $device->fill(['name' => $data['device_name'], 'os' => $data['os'], 'token_id' => $token->accessToken->id, 'last_seen_at' => now(), 'notice_version' => $policy->version, 'notice_accepted_at' => now()])->save();

            return ['user' => $user, 'device' => $device, 'token' => $token->plainTextToken, 'expires_at' => $expiry, 'policy' => $this->policyFor($device, $policy)];
        });
        Audit::record(null, 'device.enrolled', 'device', $result['device']->id, ['user_id' => $user->id, 'ip' => $request->ip()]);

        return response()->json($result);
    }

    public function heartbeat(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $device = $request->attributes->get('device');
        $device->update(['last_seen_at' => now()]);

        return response()->json(['device' => $device, 'policy' => $this->policyFor($device)]);
    }

    public function logout(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $device = $request->attributes->get('device');
        $request->user()->currentAccessToken()->delete();
        $device->update(['token_id' => null]);
        Audit::record($request, 'device.logout', 'device', $device->id);

        return response()->json(['success' => true]);
    }

    public function screenshot(Request $request, Vault $vault): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['event_id' => 'required|uuid', 'captured_at' => 'required|date|before_or_equal:'.now()->addMinutes(5)->toIso8601String(), 'file' => 'required|file|mimetypes:image/png|max:20480', 'app_name' => 'nullable|string|max:160', 'window_title' => 'nullable|string|max:1000', 'url' => 'nullable|string|max:2048']);
        $device = $request->attributes->get('device');
        $policy = MonitoringPolicy::current();
        abort_if($device->paused || ! $policy->monitoring_enabled, 409, 'Monitoring is paused by the administrator.');
        $captured = CarbonImmutable::parse($data['captured_at'])->utc();
        if ($captured->lessThan(now()->subDays($policy->retention_days))) {
            return response()->json(['accepted' => true, 'discarded' => true]);
        }
        $file = $request->file('file');
        abort_unless(file_get_contents($file->getRealPath(), false, null, 0, 8) === "\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", 422, 'Screenshot must be a PNG image.');
        $size = getimagesize($file->getRealPath());
        abort_unless($size && $size[0] * $size[1] <= 64000000, 422, 'Screenshot dimensions are too large.');
        $sha = hash_file('sha256', $file->getRealPath());
        $created = false;
        $shot = DB::transaction(function () use ($device, $data, $policy, $captured, $file, $sha, $vault, &$created): Screenshot {
            Device::whereKey($device->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            $existing = Screenshot::where('device_id', $device->id)->where('event_id', $data['event_id'])->first();
            if ($existing) {
                abort_unless(hash_equals($existing->sha256, $sha), 409, 'This event ID already belongs to a different screenshot.');

                return $existing;
            }
            $path = 'screenshots/'.$device->device_identifier.'/'.$captured->format('Y-m-d').'/'.$data['event_id'].'.png';
            $vault->put($path, file_get_contents($file->getRealPath()));
            try {
                $shot = Screenshot::create(['device_id' => $device->id, 'event_id' => $data['event_id'], 'captured_at' => $captured, 'path' => $path, 'storage' => config('tracker.storage'), 'sha256' => $sha, 'bytes' => $file->getSize(), 'app_name' => $data['app_name'] ?? '', 'window_title' => $data['window_title'] ?? '', 'url' => $policy->browser_urls ? $this->cleanURL($data['url'] ?? '') : null]);
                $device->update(['last_upload_at' => now(), 'last_seen_at' => now()]);
                $created = true;

                return $shot;
            } catch (\Throwable $error) {
                $vault->delete($path);
                throw $error;
            }
        });
        if ($created) {
            GenerateThumbnail::dispatch($shot->id);
        }

        return response()->json(['accepted' => true, 'id' => $shot->id, 'sha256' => $sha], $created ? 201 : 200);
    }

    public function activity(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['events' => 'required|array|min:1|max:100', 'events.*.event_id' => 'required|uuid', 'events.*.captured_at' => 'required|date|before_or_equal:'.now()->addMinutes(5)->toIso8601String(), 'events.*.app_name' => 'required|string|max:160', 'events.*.window_title' => 'nullable|string|max:1000', 'events.*.url' => 'nullable|string|max:2048']);
        $device = $request->attributes->get('device');
        $policy = MonitoringPolicy::current();
        abort_if($device->paused || ! $policy->monitoring_enabled, 409, 'Monitoring is paused by the administrator.');
        $accepted = [];
        DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $device, $policy, &$accepted): void {
            Device::whereKey($device->id)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
            foreach ($data['events'] as $event) {
                $accepted[] = $event['event_id'];
                $captured = CarbonImmutable::parse($event['captured_at'])->utc();
                if ($captured->lessThan(now()->subDays($policy->retention_days))) {
                    continue;
                }
                ActivityLog::firstOrCreate(['device_id' => $device->id, 'event_id' => $event['event_id']], ['captured_at' => $captured, 'app_name' => $event['app_name'], 'window_title' => $event['window_title'] ?? '', 'url' => $policy->browser_urls ? $this->cleanURL($event['url'] ?? '') : null, 'created_at' => now()]);
            }
            $device->update(['last_seen_at' => now(), 'last_upload_at' => now()]);
        });

        return response()->json(['accepted_ids' => $accepted]);
    }

    private function policyFor(Device $device, ?MonitoringPolicy $policy = null): array
    {
        $policy ??= MonitoringPolicy::current();

        return [...$policy->toArray(), 'monitoring_enabled' => $policy->monitoring_enabled && ! $device->paused, 'paused' => $device->paused];
    }

    private function cleanURL(string $value): ?string
    {
        if (! $value) {
            return null;
        }
        $hasScheme = preg_match('~^https?://~i', $value);
        $parts = parse_url($hasScheme ? $value : 'https://'.$value);
        if (! $parts || empty($parts['host']) || ! in_array(strtolower($parts['scheme'] ?? ''), ['http', 'https'], true)) {
            return null;
        }

        return ($hasScheme ? $parts['scheme'].'://' : '').$parts['host'].(isset($parts['port']) ? ':'.$parts['port'] : '').($parts['path'] ?? '');
    }
}

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;

class CreateTrackerAdmin extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'tracker:create-admin {email} {--name=Administrator}';

    protected $description = 'Create the first super administrator without a built-in default password';

    public function handle(): int
    {
        $data = ['email' => strtolower($this->argument('email')), 'name' => $this->option('name'), 'password' => $this->secret('Password (at least 12 characters)')];
        $validator = Validator::make($data, ['email' => 'required|email|unique:users,email', 'name' => 'required|string|max:120', 'password' => ['required', 'string', Password::min(12)]]);
        if ($validator->fails()) {
            $this->error($validator->errors()->first());

            return self::FAILURE;
        }
        User::create([...$data, 'role' => 'super_admin']);
        $this->info('Super administrator created.');

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Models\MonitoringPolicy;
use App\Models\Screenshot;
use App\Services\Vault;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class PruneTrackerData extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'tracker:prune';

    protected $description = 'Delete expired screenshots, activity and audit logs according to server policy';

    public function handle(Vault $vault): int
    {
        $policy = MonitoringPolicy::current();
        $failed = 0;
        Screenshot::where('captured_at', '<', now()->subDays($policy->retention_days))->chunkById(100, function ($shots) use ($vault, &$failed): void {
            foreach ($shots as $shot) {
                try {
                    DB::transaction(function () use ($shot, $vault): void {
                        // Reload after locking so a just-published thumbnail is included.
                        $current = Screenshot::whereKey($shot->id)->lockForUpdate()->first();
                        if (! $current) {
                            return;
                        }
                        if ($current->thumbnail_path) {
                            $vault->delete($current->thumbnail_path, $current->storage);
                        }
                        $vault->delete($current->path, $current->storage);
                        $current->delete();
                    });
                } catch (\Throwable $error) {
                    report($error);
                    $failed++;
                }
            }
        });
        $activity = ActivityLog::where('captured_at', '<', now()->subDays($policy->retention_days))->delete();
        $audit = AuditLog::where('created_at', '<', now()->subDays($policy->audit_retention_days))->delete();
        $this->info("Pruned activity: $activity; audit entries: $audit; screenshot failures: $failed.");

        return $failed ? self::FAILURE : self::SUCCESS;
    }
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
	"unsafe"
)

var user32 = syscall.NewLazyDLL("user32.dll")
var getForegroundWindow = user32.NewProc("GetForegroundWindow")
var getWindowText = user32.NewProc("GetWindowTextW")
var getWindowThreadProcessID = user32.NewProc("GetWindowThreadProcessId")
var queryProcessName = syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll").NewProc("QueryFullProcessImageNameW")

func readForeground(ctx context.Context, wantURLs bool) (Activity, error) {
	hwnd, _, _ := getForegroundWindow.Call()
	if hwnd == 0 {
		return Activity{}, errors.New("no foreground window")
	}
	var pid uint32
	getWindowThreadProcessID.Call(hwnd, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&pid)))
	handle, err := syscall.OpenProcess(0x1000, false, pid)
	if err != nil {
		return Activity{}, errors.New("cannot read foreground process")
	}
	defer syscall.CloseHandle(handle)
	var name [32768]uint16
	size := uint32(len(name))
	ok, _, _ := queryProcessName.Call(uintptr(handle), 0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&name[0])), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&size)))
	if ok == 0 {
		return Activity{}, errors.New("cannot read foreground process name")
	}
	var title [4096]uint16
	getWindowText.Call(hwnd, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&title[0])), uintptr(len(title)))
	item := Activity{App: filepath.Base(syscall.UTF16ToString(name[:size])), Title: syscall.UTF16ToString(title[:])}
	if wantURLs {
		switch strings.ToLower(item.App) {
		case "chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "firefox.exe", "brave.exe":
			item.URL = readBrowserAddress(ctx, hwnd)
			if item.URL == "" {
				item.URLStatus = "Browser address unavailable"
			}
		}
	}
	current, _, _ := getForegroundWindow.Call()
	if current != hwnd {
		return Activity{}, errors.New("foreground changed during sample")
	}
	return item, nil
}

func readBrowserAddress(parent context.Context, hwnd uintptr) string {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(parent, 3*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", browserAddressScript)
	hideCommand(command)
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LOCAL_TRACKER_HWND="+strconv.FormatUint(uint64(hwnd), 10))
	output, err := command.Output()
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return cleanBrowserAddress(string(output))
}

// Only read specifically named address controls; never generic page form values.
const browserAddressScript = `

package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	mathrand "math/rand"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type Agent struct {
	sync.Mutex
	transition                             sync.Mutex
	logMu                                  sync.Mutex
	config                                 Config
	root, id                               string
	queue                                  *Queue
	client                                 *Client
	session                                *Session
	cancel                                 context.CancelFunc
	tracking                               bool
	lastContact                            time.Time
	policy                                 Policy
	message, uploadMessage, captureMessage string
}

func newAgent(config Config, root string) (*Agent, error) {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0700); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "logs"), 0700); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	id, err := loadIdentity(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	queue, err := openQueue(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	a := &Agent{config: config, root: root, id: id, queue: queue, client: newClient(config.ServerURL), policy: defaultPolicy(), message: "Sign in to enroll this device.", uploadMessage: "No uploads yet.", captureMessage: "Monitoring is stopped."}
	if sealed, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "session.bin")); err == nil {
		if plain, err := protectSettings(sealed, false); err == nil {
			var session Session
			if json.Unmarshal(plain, &session) == nil && session.ServerURL == config.ServerURL && session.ExpiresAt.After(time.Now()) {
				a.useSession(session)
			}
		}
	}
	return a, nil
}
func (a *Agent) sessionCopy() *Session {
	a.Lock()
	defer a.Unlock()
	if a.session == nil {
		return nil
	}
	copy := *a.session
	return &copy
}
func (a *Agent) useSession(session Session) {
	session.Policy = session.Policy.bounded()
	a.Lock()
	if a.cancel != nil {
		a.cancel()
		a.cancel = nil
	}
	a.session = &session
	a.policy = session.Policy
	a.tracking = session.Policy.MonitoringEnabled && session.ExpiresAt.After(time.Now())
	a.message = "Monitoring follows your organization's policy."
	if a.tracking {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		a.cancel = cancel
		a.message = "Monitoring active. Screenshots and app activity are collected and uploaded."
		go a.capture(ctx, session)
		go a.activity(ctx, session)
		go a.uploads(ctx, session)
	} else {
		a.message = "Monitoring paused by the administrator."
		a.captureMessage = "Capture is paused."
	}
	message := a.message
	a.Unlock()
	a.localLog("session.policy", "", message)
}
func (a *Agent) persist(session Session) error {
	session.ServerURL = a.config.ServerURL
	data, err := json.Marshal(session)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sealed, err := protectSettings(data, true)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return atomicWrite(filepath.Join(a.root, "session.bin"), sealed)
}
func (a *Agent) login(ctx context.Context, email, password string, accepted bool) error {
	a.transition.Lock()
	defer a.transition.Unlock()
	if !accepted {
		return errors.New("read and accept the monitoring notice first")
	}
	var session Session
	err := a.client.request(ctx, "/api/agent/login", "", map[string]any{"email": email, "password": password, "device_identifier": a.id, "device_name": a.config.DeviceName, "os": "windows", "notice_accepted": true}, &session)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if session.Token == "" || session.User.ID == "" || !session.ExpiresAt.After(time.Now()) {
		return errors.New("server returned an invalid login confirmation")
	}
	session.ServerURL = a.config.ServerURL
	a.useSession(session)
	a.Lock()
	a.lastContact = time.Now()
	a.Unlock()
	if err := a.persist(session); err != nil {
		a.Lock()
		a.message += " Credentials could not be saved by Windows; sign in again after restarting."
		a.Unlock()
		a.localLog("credentials.not_saved", "", err.Error())
	}
	return nil
}
func (a *Agent) stopSession(message string) {
	a.Lock()
	if a.cancel != nil {
		a.cancel()
		a.cancel = nil
	}
	a.session = nil
	a.tracking = false
	a.message = message
	a.captureMessage = "Monitoring is stopped."
	a.Unlock()
	os.Remove(filepath.Join(a.root, "session.bin"))
	a.localLog("session.stopped", "", message)
}
func (a *Agent) logout() {
	a.transition.Lock()
	defer a.transition.Unlock()
	session := a.sessionCopy()
	a.stopSession("Signed out. Pending records remain on disk until the same employee reconnects or retention expires.")
	if session != nil {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		a.client.request(ctx, "/api/agent/logout", session.Token, map[string]any{}, nil)
	}
}
func (a *Agent) background(ctx context.Context) {
	for {
		a.refresh(ctx)
		a.Lock()
		days := a.policy.OfflineDays
		a.Unlock()
		if count := a.queue.prune(days); count > 0 {
			a.localLog("queue.expired", "", fmt.Sprintf("%d records exceeded offline retention", count))
		}
		a.pruneLogs()
		if !waitFor(ctx, 30*time.Second) {
			return
		}
	}
}
func (a *Agent) refresh(parent context.Context) {
	a.transition.Lock()
	defer a.transition.Unlock()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(parent, 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	session := a.sessionCopy()
	if session == nil {
		var info struct {
			Policy Policy `json:"policy"`
		}
		if a.client.request(ctx, "/api/agent/info", "", nil, &info) == nil {
			a.Lock()
			if a.session == nil {
				a.policy = info.Policy.bounded()
				a.lastContact = time.Now()
			}
			a.Unlock()
		}
		return
	}
	if !session.ExpiresAt.After(time.Now()) {
		a.stopSession("Session expired. Sign in again.")
		return
	}
	var result struct {
		Policy Policy `json:"policy"`
	}
	if err := a.client.request(ctx, "/api/agent/heartbeat", session.Token, map[string]any{}, &result); err != nil {
		current := a.sessionCopy()
		if current == nil || current.Token != session.Token {
			return
		}
		var apiErr *APIError
		if errors.As(err, &apiErr) && (apiErr.Code == 401 || apiErr.Code == 403) {
			a.stopSession("Device access revoked or account disabled. Contact your administrator.")
			return
		}
		a.Lock()
		a.message = "Server unavailable. Monitoring continues under the last received policy; uploads are queued within the storage limit."
		a.Unlock()
		return
	}
	current := a.sessionCopy()
	if current == nil || current.Token != session.Token {
		return
	}
	result.Policy = result.Policy.bounded()
	a.Lock()
	a.lastContact = time.Now()
	a.message = "Connected. Monitoring follows your organization's policy."
	a.Unlock()
	if result.Policy != session.Policy {
		session.Policy = result.Policy
		a.useSession(*session)
		a.persist(*session)
	}
}
func (a *Agent) status(showUser bool) map[string]any {
	a.Lock()
	defer a.Unlock()
	count, bytes := a.queue.stats()
	result := map[string]any{"device_identifier": a.id, "device_name": a.config.DeviceName, "server_url": a.config.ServerURL, "tracking": a.tracking, "message": a.message, "notice": a.policy.Notice, "policy": a.policy, "pending": count, "queue_mb": float64(bytes/1024) / 1024, "last_contact": a.lastContact, "upload_message": a.uploadMessage, "capture_message": a.captureMessage, "user": nil}
	if showUser && a.session != nil {
		result["user"] = a.session.User
	}
	if a.lastContact.IsZero() {
		result["last_contact"] = nil
	}
	result["failed_uploads"] = a.queue.failedCount()
	return result
}
func (a *Agent) activity(ctx context.Context, session Session) {
	for {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return
		}
		sample, err := readForeground(ctx, session.Policy.BrowserURLs)
		if err == nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
			event := Event{ID: uuid(), CapturedAt: time.Now().UTC(), App: truncate(sample.App, 160), Title: truncate(sample.Title, 1000), URL: truncate(sample.URL, 2048)}
			if err := a.queue.add(Job{Event: event, Kind: "activity", UserID: session.User.ID}, session.Policy.QueueMB); err != nil {
				a.setUploadMessage(err.Error())
			}
		}
		if !waitFor(ctx, time.Duration(session.Policy.ActivitySeconds)*time.Second) {
			return
		}
	}
}
func (a *Agent) capture(ctx context.Context, session Session) {
	period := time.Duration(session.Policy.ScreenshotSeconds) * time.Second
	start := time.Now()
	for {
		start = currentCaptureWindow(start, time.Now(), period)
		base := time.Now()
		if base.Before(start) {
			base = start
		}
		remaining := start.Add(period).Sub(base)
		if remaining <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		target := base.Add(time.Duration(mathrand.Int63n(int64(remaining))))
		if !waitFor(ctx, time.Until(target)) {
			return
		}
		if time.Now().Before(start.Add(period)) {
			id := uuid()
			file := id + ".png"
			path := filepath.Join(a.root, "payloads", file)
			captured := time.Now().UTC()
			err := captureScreenContext(ctx, path)
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				os.Remove(path)
				return
			}
			if err == nil {
				info, statErr := os.Stat(path)
				if statErr != nil {
					err = statErr
				} else if info.Size() > 20*1024*1024 {
					err = errors.New("screenshot exceeds the 20 MB server limit")
				} else {
					sample, _ := readForeground(ctx, session.Policy.BrowserURLs)
					if ctx.Err() != nil {
						os.Remove(path)
						return
					}
					event := Event{ID: id, CapturedAt: captured, App: truncate(sample.App, 160), Title: truncate(sample.Title, 1000), URL: truncate(sample.URL, 2048)}
					err = a.queue.add(Job{Event: event, Kind: "screenshot", UserID: session.User.ID, File: file, Bytes: info.Size()}, session.Policy.QueueMB)
				}
			}
			a.Lock()
			if err != nil {
				os.Remove(path)
				a.captureMessage = "Capture failed: " + err.Error()
			} else {
				a.captureMessage = "Screenshot queued at " + captured.Local().Format("15:04:05")
			}
			a.Unlock()
		}
		start = start.Add(period)
	}
}

// Preserve fixed windows, skipping elapsed windows without replaying captures.
func currentCaptureWindow(start, now time.Time, period time.Duration) time.Time {
	if !now.Before(start.Add(period)) {
		return start.Add((now.Sub(start) / period) * period)
	}
	return start
}
func (a *Agent) uploads(ctx context.Context, session Session) {
	for {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return
		}
		jobs := a.queue.ready(session.User.ID, time.Now(), 50)
		activities := []Job{}
		for _, job := range jobs {
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return
			}
			if job.Kind == "activity" {
				activities = append(activities, job)
				continue
			}
			err := a.client.upload(ctx, session.Token, a.root, job)
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return
			}
			a.finishJob(job, err)
		}
		if len(activities) > 0 && ctx.Err() == nil {
			events := make([]Event, 0, len(activities))
			for _, job := range activities {
				events = append(events, job.Event)
			}
			var result struct {
				IDs []string `json:"accepted_ids"`
			}
			err := a.client.request(ctx, "/api/agent/activity", session.Token, map[string]any{"events": events}, &result)
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return
			}
			acknowledged := map[string]bool{}
			for _, id := range result.IDs {
				acknowledged[id] = true
			}
			for _, job := range activities {
				jobErr := err
				if jobErr == nil && !acknowledged[job.ID] {
					jobErr = errors.New("server did not confirm this event")
				}
				a.finishJob(job, jobErr)
			}
		}
		if !waitFor(ctx, 3*time.Second) {
			return
		}
	}
}
func (a *Agent) finishJob(job Job, err error) {
	if err != nil {
		var apiErr *APIError
		var queueErr error
		if errors.As(err, &apiErr) && (apiErr.Code == 400 || apiErr.Code == 413 || apiErr.Code == 415 || apiErr.Code == 422) {
			queueErr = a.queue.reject(job.ID)
		} else {
			queueErr = a.queue.retry(job.ID)
		}
		if queueErr != nil {
			a.setUploadMessage("Cannot persist upload failure: " + queueErr.Error())
			return
		}
		if a.queue.failedCount() > 0 {
			a.setUploadMessage("Rejected uploads retained locally for inspection until retention expires.")
			a.localLog("upload.retained_failure", job.ID, err.Error())
			return
		}
		a.setUploadMessage("Upload deferred: " + err.Error())
		a.localLog("upload.failed", job.ID, err.Error())
		return
	}
	if err = a.queue.ack(job.ID); err != nil {
		a.setUploadMessage("Server confirmed upload, but local cleanup failed.")
		return
	}
	a.setUploadMessage("Last successful upload: " + time.Now().Format("15:04:05"))
	a.localLog("upload.confirmed", job.ID, job.Kind)
}
func (a *Agent) setUploadMessage(message string) { a.Lock(); a.uploadMessage = message; a.Unlock() }
func (a *Agent) localLog(action, id, message string) {
	a.logMu.Lock()
	defer a.logMu.Unlock()
	file, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(a.root, "logs", time.Now().UTC().Format("2006-01-02")+".jsonl"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		log.Print("Cannot write local upload log")
		return
	}
	defer file.Close()
	json.NewEncoder(file).Encode(map[string]any{"at": time.Now().UTC(), "action": action, "event_id": id, "message": message})
}
func (a *Agent) pruneLogs() {
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(a.root, "logs"))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		stamp, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02.jsonl", entry.Name())
		if err == nil && stamp.Before(time.Now().Add(-30*24*time.Hour)) {
			os.Remove(filepath.Join(a.root, "logs", entry.Name()))
		}
	}
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

// Capture the entire virtual desktop (all monitors) using Windows' built-in APIs.
func captureScreen(path string) error {
	return captureScreenContext(context.Background(), path)
}

func captureScreenContext(parent context.Context, path string) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(parent, 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", captureScript)
	command.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{HideWindow: true}
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LOCAL_CLOCK_SCREENSHOT="+path)
	output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", err, output)
	}
	return nil
}

const captureScript = `
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
Add-Type -TypeDefinition 'using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public class ClockDpi { [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetProcessDPIAware(); [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(IntPtr value); [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext(IntPtr value); }'
try {
    [ClockDpi]::SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext([IntPtr](-4)) | Out-Null
    [ClockDpi]::SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext([IntPtr](-4)) | Out-Null
} catch { [ClockDpi]::SetProcessDPIAware() | Out-Null }
$bounds = [System.Windows.Forms.SystemInformation]::VirtualScreen
$bitmap = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($bounds.Width, $bounds.Height)
try {
    $graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bitmap)
    try {
        $graphics.CopyFromScreen($bounds.Left, $bounds.Top, 0, 0, $bounds.Size)
        $bitmap.Save($env:LOCAL_CLOCK_SCREENSHOT, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
    } finally { $graphics.Dispose() }
} finally { $bitmap.Dispose() }
`

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime/multipart"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"
)

type APIError struct {
	Code    int
	Message string
}

func (e *APIError) Error() string { return e.Message }

type Client struct {
	base string
	http *http.Client
}

func newClient(base string) *Client {
	return &Client{base: base, http: &http.Client{Timeout: 50 * time.Second, CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}}
}
func (c *Client) request(ctx context.Context, path, token string, input any, output any) error {
	var body io.Reader
	method := "GET"
	if input != nil {
		data, err := json.Marshal(input)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		body = bytes.NewReader(data)
		method = "POST"
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, c.base+path, body)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	return c.send(req, token, output)
}
func (c *Client) send(req *http.Request, token string, output any) error {
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	if token != "" {
		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	}
	response, err := c.http.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("server connection failed; records remain queued")
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode < 200 || response.StatusCode >= 300 {
		var body struct {
			Message string `json:"message"`
		}
		json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 8192)).Decode(&body)
		if body.Message == "" {
			body.Message = fmt.Sprintf("Server returned HTTP %d", response.StatusCode)
		}
		return &APIError{response.StatusCode, body.Message}
	}
	if output != nil {
		if err := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 1024*1024)).Decode(output); err != nil {
			return errors.New("server confirmation could not be read; record retained")
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func (c *Client) upload(ctx context.Context, token, root string, job Job) error {
	file, err := os.Open(filepath.Join(root, "payloads", job.File))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	var buffer bytes.Buffer
	writer := multipart.NewWriter(&buffer)
	part, err := writer.CreateFormFile("file", job.File)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err = io.Copy(part, file); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for key, value := range map[string]string{"event_id": job.ID, "captured_at": job.CapturedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), "app_name": job.App, "window_title": job.Title, "url": job.URL} {
		if err := writer.WriteField(key, value); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", c.base+"/api/agent/screenshots", &buffer)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", writer.FormDataContentType())
	var result struct {
		Accepted bool `json:"accepted"`
	}
	if err := c.send(req, token, &result); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !result.Accepted {
		return errors.New("server did not acknowledge screenshot")
	}
	return nil
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"embed"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"log"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"os/signal"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

//go:embed ui/*
var webFiles embed.FS

func main() {
	configFile := flag.String("config", "agent-config.json", "administrator-managed configuration file")
	noBrowser := flag.Bool("no-browser", false, "do not open the local status window automatically")
	flag.Parse()
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	root := filepath.Dir(executable)
	path := *configFile
	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
		path = filepath.Join(root, path)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal("Copy agent-config.example.json to agent-config.json and set your server URL.")
	}
	var config Config
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &config); err != nil {
		log.Fatal("Invalid agent configuration")
	}
	config.ServerURL = strings.TrimRight(config.ServerURL, "/")
	if !secureServer(config.ServerURL) {
		log.Fatal("Server URL must use HTTPS or an HTTP loopback IP.")
	}
	if config.DeviceName == "" {
		config.DeviceName, _ = os.Hostname()
	}
	if config.Listen == "" {
		config.Listen = "127.0.0.1:8765"
	}
	host, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(config.Listen)
	if err != nil || net.ParseIP(host) == nil || !net.ParseIP(host).IsLoopback() {
		log.Fatal("The local agent must listen on a loopback IP.")
	}
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", config.Listen)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal("Cannot start local agent. It may already be running: ", err)
	}
	agent, err := newAgent(config, filepath.Join(root, "data"))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	origin := "http://" + listener.Addr().String()
	uiToken := uuid() + uuid()
	mux := agentHandler(agent, origin, uiToken)
	server := &http.Server{Handler: mux, ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second}
	ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt)
	defer cancel()
	go agent.background(ctx)
	go runTray(ctx, origin+"/agent", func() bool { agent.Lock(); defer agent.Unlock(); return agent.tracking })
	go func() {
		<-ctx.Done()
		agent.Lock()
		if agent.cancel != nil {
			agent.cancel()
		}
		agent.Unlock()
		server.Close()
	}()
	fmt.Printf("Activity agent running at %s/agent\nMonitoring is visible and follows the server policy after login.\nKeep this console open. Press Ctrl+C to exit.\n", origin)
	if !*noBrowser {
		openBrowser(origin + "/agent")
	}
	if err := server.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func openBrowser(address string) {
	var command *exec.Cmd
	switch runtime.GOOS {
	case "windows":
		command = exec.Command("rundll32", "url.dll,FileProtocolHandler", address)
	case "darwin":
		command = exec.Command("open", address)
	default:
		command = exec.Command("xdg-open", address)
	}
	hideCommand(command)
	if command.Start() == nil {
		go command.Wait()
	}
}
func agentHandler(agent *Agent, origin, uiToken string) http.Handler {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	authenticated := func(r *http.Request) bool {
		cookie, err := r.Cookie("activity_agent")
		return err == nil && subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(cookie.Value), []byte(uiToken)) == 1
	}
	writeAllowed := func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
		if r.Method != "POST" {
			http.Error(w, "Method not allowed", 405)
			return false
		}
		if r.Header.Get("Origin") != origin || !strings.HasPrefix(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"), "application/json") {
			http.Error(w, "Invalid request origin", 403)
			return false
		}
		return true
	}
	mux.HandleFunc("/local/status", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(agent.status(authenticated(r)))
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("/local/login", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !writeAllowed(w, r) {
			return
		}
		var input struct {
			Email    string `json:"email"`
			Password string `json:"password"`
			Accepted bool   `json:"notice_accepted"`
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 8192)).Decode(&input); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "Invalid login request", 400)
			return
		}
		if err := agent.login(r.Context(), input.Email, input.Password, input.Accepted); err != nil {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			w.WriteHeader(422)
			json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"message": err.Error()})
			return
		}
		http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: "activity_agent", Value: uiToken, Path: "/", HttpOnly: true, SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode})
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]bool{"success": true})
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("/local/logout", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !writeAllowed(w, r) {
			return
		}
		if !authenticated(r) {
			http.Error(w, "Login required", 401)
			return
		}
		agent.logout()
		http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: "activity_agent", Path: "/", HttpOnly: true, SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode, MaxAge: -1})
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		fmt.Fprint(w, "{}")
	})
	ui, _ := fs.Sub(webFiles, "ui")
	mux.Handle("/ui/", http.StripPrefix("/ui/", http.FileServer(http.FS(ui))))
	mux.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.URL.Path == "/" {
			http.Redirect(w, r, "/agent", 303)
			return
		}
		if r.URL.Path != "/agent" {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		data, err := fs.ReadFile(ui, "index.html")
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "Build the Vue frontend first.", 503)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
		w.Write(data)
	})
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if "http://"+r.Host != origin {
			http.Error(w, "Invalid host", 403)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		w.Header().Set("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
		w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
		mux.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type Queue struct {
	sync.Mutex
	root string
	jobs map[string]Job
	used int64
}

var ErrQueueFull = errors.New("offline queue is full; new records are skipped until uploads free space")

func openQueue(root string) (*Queue, error) {
	q := &Queue{root: root, jobs: map[string]Job{}}
	for _, folder := range []string{"outbox", "payloads", "quarantine"} {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, folder), 0700); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root, "outbox"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() || filepath.Ext(entry.Name()) != ".json" {
			continue
		}
		bytes, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "outbox", entry.Name()))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		var job Job
		if json.Unmarshal(bytes, &job) != nil || !validID(job.ID) || job.UserID == "" || job.CapturedAt.IsZero() || job.Attempts < 0 || job.Attempts > 100 || entry.Name() != job.ID+".json" || (job.Kind != "activity" && job.Kind != "screenshot") || (job.Kind == "screenshot" && job.File != job.ID+".png") || (job.Kind == "activity" && job.File != "") {
			if err := q.quarantine(entry.Name()); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			continue
		}
		if job.Kind == "screenshot" {
			info, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(root, "payloads", job.File))
			if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
				if err := q.quarantine(entry.Name()); err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				continue
			}
			job.Bytes = info.Size() + int64(len(bytes))
		} else {
			job.Bytes = int64(len(bytes))
		}
		q.jobs[job.ID] = job
		q.used += job.Bytes
	}
	quarantined, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root, "quarantine"))
	for _, entry := range quarantined {
		if info, err := entry.Info(); err == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			q.used += info.Size()
		}
	}
	// Only orphan payloads from interrupted writes are removed; queued files stay.
	payloads, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root, "payloads"))
	for _, file := range payloads {
		if file.IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		name := file.Name()
		id := name[:len(name)-len(filepath.Ext(name))]
		if validID(id) {
			if _, ok := q.jobs[id]; !ok {
				os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, "payloads", name))
			}
		}
	}
	return q, nil
}
func (q *Queue) add(job Job, maxMB int) error {
	q.Lock()
	defer q.Unlock()
	if !validID(job.ID) || job.UserID == "" {
		return errors.New("invalid queued event")
	}
	if _, ok := q.jobs[job.ID]; ok {
		return nil
	}
	data, _ := json.Marshal(job)
	// Reserve space for retry timestamps, counters and the terminal failure marker.
	job.Bytes += int64(len(data)) + 256
	if q.used+job.Bytes > int64(maxMB)*1024*1024 {
		return ErrQueueFull
	}
	if err := writeJSON(filepath.Join(q.root, "outbox", job.ID+".json"), job); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	q.jobs[job.ID] = job
	q.used += job.Bytes
	return nil
}
func (q *Queue) ready(userID string, now time.Time, limit int) []Job {
	q.Lock()
	defer q.Unlock()
	jobs := []Job{}
	for _, job := range q.jobs {
		if job.UserID == userID && job.Failure == "" && !job.NextAttempt.After(now) {
			jobs = append(jobs, job)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(jobs, func(i, j int) bool { return jobs[i].CapturedAt.Before(jobs[j].CapturedAt) })
	if len(jobs) > limit {
		jobs = jobs[:limit]
	}
	return jobs
}
func (q *Queue) ack(id string) error {
	q.Lock()
	defer q.Unlock()
	job, ok := q.jobs[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	// Remove the manifest first; a crash leaves only an orphan, not a broken job.
	if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(q.root, "outbox", id+".json")); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return err
	}
	if job.File != "" {
		os.Remove(filepath.Join(q.root, "payloads", job.File))
	}
	delete(q.jobs, id)
	q.used -= job.Bytes
	return nil
}
func (q *Queue) retry(id string) error {
	q.Lock()
	defer q.Unlock()
	job, ok := q.jobs[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	job.Attempts++
	if job.Attempts >= 100 {
		job.Failure = "retry limit reached"
	}
	exponent := job.Attempts
	if exponent > 8 {
		exponent = 8
	}
	job.NextAttempt = time.Now().Add(time.Duration(1<<exponent) * time.Second)
	if err := writeJSON(filepath.Join(q.root, "outbox", id+".json"), job); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	q.jobs[id] = job
	return nil
}
func (q *Queue) reject(id string) error {
	q.Lock()
	defer q.Unlock()
	job, ok := q.jobs[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	job.Failure = "server permanently rejected record"
	if err := writeJSON(filepath.Join(q.root, "outbox", id+".json"), job); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	q.jobs[id] = job
	return nil
}
func (q *Queue) failedCount() int {
	q.Lock()
	defer q.Unlock()
	count := 0
	for _, job := range q.jobs {
		if job.Failure != "" {
			count++
		}
	}
	return count
}

// Derive the payload name from the manifest filename, never untrusted JSON paths.
func (q *Queue) quarantine(name string) error {
	id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".json")
	if err := os.Rename(filepath.Join(q.root, "outbox", name), filepath.Join(q.root, "quarantine", name)); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("quarantine record: %w", err)
	}
	if validID(id) {
		err := os.Rename(filepath.Join(q.root, "payloads", id+".png"), filepath.Join(q.root, "quarantine", id+".png"))
		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
			return fmt.Errorf("quarantine payload: %w", err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func (q *Queue) prune(days int) int {
	q.Lock()
	ids := []string{}
	cutoff := time.Now().Add(-time.Duration(days) * 24 * time.Hour)
	for id, job := range q.jobs {
		if job.CapturedAt.Before(cutoff) {
			ids = append(ids, id)
		}
	}
	q.Unlock()
	count := 0
	for _, id := range ids {
		if q.ack(id) == nil {
			count++
		}
	}
	q.Lock()
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(q.root, "quarantine"))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if info, err := entry.Info(); err == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular() && info.ModTime().Before(cutoff) {
			if os.Remove(filepath.Join(q.root, "quarantine", entry.Name())) == nil {
				q.used -= info.Size()
				count++
			}
		}
	}
	q.Unlock()
	return count
}
func (q *Queue) stats() (int, int64) { q.Lock(); defer q.Unlock(); return len(q.jobs), q.used }

func queuedEvent() Job {

}
func TestQueueSurvivesRestartAndAcknowledgement(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	q, err := openQueue(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	job := queuedEvent()
	if err := q.add(job, 50); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := q.retry(job.ID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	loaded, err := openQueue(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if jobs := loaded.ready(job.UserID, time.Now(), 10); len(jobs) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("retry delay was not retained")
	}
	jobs := loaded.ready(job.UserID, time.Now().Add(time.Hour), 10)
	if len(jobs) != 1 || jobs[0].ID != job.ID || jobs[0].Attempts != 1 {
		t.Fatal("queued job changed across restart")
	}
	if len(loaded.ready("another-user", time.Now().Add(time.Hour), 10)) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("another employee received queued data")
	}
	if err := loaded.ack(job.ID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	loaded, err = openQueue(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	count, _ := loaded.stats()
	if count != 0 {
		t.Fatal("acknowledged job reappeared")
	}
}

		t.Fatal("expired job not pruned")

	}
}

func TestCaptureWindowsSkipSleepWithoutReplaying(t *testing.T) {
	start := time.Unix(0, 0)
	period := 120 * time.Second
	for _, test := range []struct{ elapsed, want time.Duration }{{0, 0}, {119 * time.Second, 0}, {120 * time.Second, 120 * time.Second}, {719 * time.Second, 600 * time.Second}, {720 * time.Second, 720 * time.Second}} {
		got := currentCaptureWindow(start, start.Add(test.elapsed), period)
		if !got.Equal(start.Add(test.want)) {
			t.Fatalf("elapsed %v: %v", test.elapsed, got)
		}
	}
	if !currentCaptureWindow(start.Add(period), start.Add(30*time.Second), period).Equal(start.Add(period)) {
		t.Fatal("replayed consumed window")
	}
}

//go:build !windows

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"errors"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

func hideCommand(command *exec.Cmd) { command.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{HideWindow: true} }

// Windows DPAPI binds saved connection details to the current Windows account.
func protectSettings(data []byte, encrypt bool) ([]byte, error) {
	action := "Unprotect"
	if encrypt {
		action = "Protect"
	}
	script := "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Security; $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $data=[Convert]::FromBase64String([Console]::In.ReadToEnd()); $result=[Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData]::" + action + "($data,$null,[Security.Cryptography.DataProtectionScope]::CurrentUser); [Console]::Out.Write([Convert]::ToBase64String($result))"
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", script)
	hideCommand(command)
	command.Stdin = strings.NewReader(base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data))
	var stdout bytes.Buffer
	command.Stdout = &stdout
	if err := command.Run(); err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("Windows settings encryption is unavailable")
	}
	return base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()))
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"runtime"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

type trayWindowClass struct {
	Size, Style                        uint32
	Procedure                          uintptr
	ClassExtra, WindowExtra            int32
	Instance, Icon, Cursor, Background uintptr
	MenuName, ClassName                *uint16
	SmallIcon                          uintptr
}
type trayNotification struct {
	Size                uint32
	Window              uintptr
	ID, Flags, Callback uint32
	Icon                uintptr
	Tip                 [128]uint16
	State, StateMask    uint32
	Info                [256]uint16
	Version             uint32
	InfoTitle           [64]uint16
	InfoFlags           uint32
	GUID                [16]byte
	BalloonIcon         uintptr
}
type trayMessage struct {
	Window         uintptr
	Message        uint32
	WParam, LParam uintptr
	Time           uint32
	Point          [2]int32
	Private        uint32
}

func runTray(ctx context.Context, address string, tracking func() bool) {
	runtime.LockOSThread()
	defer runtime.UnlockOSThread()
	api := syscall.NewLazyDLL("user32.dll")
	shell := syscall.NewLazyDLL("shell32.dll")
	kernel := syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll")
	instance, _, _ := kernel.NewProc("GetModuleHandleW").Call(0)
	icon, _, _ := api.NewProc("LoadIconW").Call(0, 32512)
	name, _ := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString("ActivityPlatformTray")
	var notify trayNotification
	notify.Size = uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(notify))
	notify.ID = 1
	notify.Flags = 1 | 2 | 4
	notify.Callback = 0x8001
	notify.Icon = icon
	setTip := func() {
		text := "Activity: signed out / paused — click to view"
		if tracking() {
			text = "Activity: monitoring active — click to view"
		}
		notify.Tip = [128]uint16{}
		value, _ := syscall.UTF16FromString(text)
		copy(notify.Tip[:], value)
	}
	callback := syscall.NewCallback(func(hwnd uintptr, message uint32, wparam, lparam uintptr) uintptr {
		switch message {
		case 0x8001:
			if lparam == 0x202 || lparam == 0x205 || lparam == 0x203 {
				go openBrowser(address)
			}
			return 0
		case 0x113:
			setTip()
			shell.NewProc("Shell_NotifyIconW").Call(1, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&notify)))
			return 0
		case 0x10:
			api.NewProc("DestroyWindow").Call(hwnd)
			return 0
		case 0x2:
			shell.NewProc("Shell_NotifyIconW").Call(2, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&notify)))
			api.NewProc("PostQuitMessage").Call(0)
			return 0
		}
		result, _, _ := api.NewProc("DefWindowProcW").Call(hwnd, uintptr(message), wparam, lparam)
		return result
	})
	class := trayWindowClass{Instance: instance, Procedure: callback, ClassName: name}
	class.Size = uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(class))
	if result, _, _ := api.NewProc("RegisterClassExW").Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&class))); result == 0 {
		return
	}
	hwnd, _, _ := api.NewProc("CreateWindowExW").Call(0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(name)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(name)), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, instance, 0)
	if hwnd == 0 {
		return
	}
	notify.Window = hwnd
	setTip()
	shell.NewProc("Shell_NotifyIconW").Call(0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&notify)))
	api.NewProc("SetTimer").Call(hwnd, 1, 3000, 0)
	go func() { <-ctx.Done(); api.NewProc("PostMessageW").Call(hwnd, 0x10, 0, 0) }()
	var message trayMessage
	for {
		result, _, _ := api.NewProc("GetMessageW").Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&message)), 0, 0, 0)
		if int32(result) <= 0 {
			break
		}
		api.NewProc("TranslateMessage").Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&message)))
		api.NewProc("DispatchMessageW").Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&message)))
	}
}

package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"

type User struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Email string `json:"email"`
}
type Policy struct {
	Version           int    `json:"version"`
	MonitoringEnabled bool   `json:"monitoring_enabled"`
	ScreenshotSeconds int    `json:"screenshot_interval_seconds"`
	ActivitySeconds   int    `json:"activity_interval_seconds"`
	BrowserURLs       bool   `json:"browser_urls"`
	QueueMB           int    `json:"offline_queue_max_mb"`
	OfflineDays       int    `json:"offline_retention_days"`
	Notice            string `json:"notice"`
}

func defaultPolicy() Policy {
	return Policy{ScreenshotSeconds: 120, ActivitySeconds: 5, QueueMB: 512, OfflineDays: 7, Notice: "This agent records desktop screenshots and foreground application activity while signed in, under your organization's monitoring policy. Contact the server to load the current notice before signing in."}
}
func (p Policy) bounded() Policy {
	if p.ScreenshotSeconds < 30 || p.ScreenshotSeconds > 3600 {
		p.ScreenshotSeconds = 120
	}
	if p.ActivitySeconds < 5 || p.ActivitySeconds > 300 {
		p.ActivitySeconds = 5
	}
	if p.QueueMB < 50 || p.QueueMB > 10240 {
		p.QueueMB = 512
	}
	if p.OfflineDays < 1 || p.OfflineDays > 30 {
		p.OfflineDays = 7
	}
	return p
}

func uuid() string {
	var b [16]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(b[:]); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	b[6] = (b[6] & 15) | 64
	b[8] = (b[8] & 63) | 128
	h := hex.EncodeToString(b[:])
	return h[:8] + "-" + h[8:12] + "-" + h[12:16] + "-" + h[16:20] + "-" + h[20:]
}
func secureServer(address string) bool {
	u, err := url.Parse(address)
	if err != nil || u.Hostname() == "" || u.User != nil || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" {
		return false
	}
	ip := net.ParseIP(u.Hostname())
	return u.Scheme == "https" || (u.Scheme == "http" && ip != nil && ip.IsLoopback())
}
func writeJSON(path string, value any) error {
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return atomicWrite(path, data)
}
func atomicWrite(path string, data []byte) error {
	temp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".pending-*")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	name := temp.Name()
	defer os.Remove(name)
	if err = temp.Chmod(0600); err == nil {
		_, err = temp.Write(data)
	}
	if err == nil {
		err = temp.Sync()
	}
	closeErr := temp.Close()
	if err == nil {
		err = closeErr
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.Rename(name, path)
}
func loadIdentity(root string) (string, error) {
	path := filepath.Join(root, "device-id")
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err == nil {
		value := strings.TrimSpace(string(data))
		if !validID(value) {
			return "", errors.New("invalid saved device ID")
		}
		return value, nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return "", err
	}
	value := uuid()
	return value, atomicWrite(path, []byte(value))
}
func validID(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != 36 {
		return false
	}
	for i, c := range value {
		if i == 8 || i == 13 || i == 18 || i == 23 {
			if c != '-' {
				return false
			}
		} else if !strings.ContainsRune("0123456789abcdef", c) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func waitFor(ctx context.Context, d time.Duration) bool {
	timer := time.NewTimer(d)
	defer timer.Stop()
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return false
	case <-timer.C:
		return ctx.Err() == nil
	}
}
func truncate(value string, length int) string {
	r := []rune(value)
	if len(r) > length {
		return string(r[:length])
	}
	return value
}
func cleanBrowserAddress(value string) string {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	if value == "" || strings.ContainsAny(value, "\r\n\t ") {
		return ""
	}
	scheme := strings.HasPrefix(value, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "https://")
	address := value
	if !scheme {
		if strings.Contains(value, "://") {
			return ""
		}
		address = "https://" + value
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(address)
	if err != nil || u.Hostname() == "" {
		return ""
	}
	host := u.Hostname()
	if !scheme && !strings.Contains(host, ".") && host != "localhost" && net.ParseIP(host) == nil {
		return ""
	}
	u.User = nil
	u.RawQuery = ""
	u.ForceQuery = false
	u.Fragment = ""
	u.RawFragment = ""
	if scheme {
		return u.String()
	}
	return u.Host + u.EscapedPath()
}
